purpose: Cover AC-15601-1 (rcf feedback preview renders each pending entry as the title and body that would be filed, lists the destination, and prints the redaction ledger over the full eight-rule vocabulary), AC-15601-2 (preview marks residual-secret findings so the operator sees before consenting; the submit half of AC-15601-2 lands with slice 4), AC-15601-3 (preview never mutates the stored entries.jsonl), AC-15601-4 (a final whole-text residual-secret pass on the fully rendered and normalised issue body and each bundle refuses submit on any hit) and AC-15701-1 (a stable 12-hex fingerprint is attached per entry, folds across blueprint versions when the anchor+class match, and falls back to normalised-title tokens with a warning when the anchor is absent).
title: Slice 2 (FBS-181): rcf feedback preview renders redacted issue text, surfaces residual-secret markers, leaves the store byte-invariant, and attaches a stable fingerprint

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 via the CLI test: --json emits titleRendered, bodyRendered, destination { repo, visibility } and a ledger whose rule names include project-root, absolute-path, email, hostname, private-ip, secret-token, operator-identity and size-shape; the rendered body carries none of the raw secret substrings, no private IP, no operator-name tokens, no em-dash, and stays under the byte cap.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-preview.test.js::AC-15601-1: rcf feedback preview --json emits rendered title, body, destination and full-vocabulary ledger

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-2 (preview half) via the CLI test: an obfuscated token embedded in a longer identifier is caught by the second-pass residual check and surfaced with the residual-secret marker on that entry, while a clean entry reports residual: []. The submit half of the AC lands with slice 4 once the submit path exists.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-preview.test.js::AC-15601-2: preview surfaces a residual-secret line so the agent can rewrite before submit

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-3 via the CLI test: sha-256 of .rcf/feedback/entries.jsonl is invariant across two preview runs (text + --json).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-preview.test.js::AC-15601-3: preview never mutates the stored entries.jsonl (sha-256 invariant)

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-1 via the CLI test: two entries with the same kind, targetKey, anchor and symptomClass yield identical fingerprints.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-preview.test.js::AC-15701-1: preview attaches a stable fingerprint per entry and it does not shift across blueprint versions

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-1 (fallback arm) via the CLI test: an entry with no anchor triggers the fingerprintFallback flag in --json and a warning banner in text mode so the agent learns to supply an anchor.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-preview.test.js::AC-15701-1 (fallback): missing anchor triggers the fingerprintFallback flag and a warning banner in text mode

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fixture corpus for the redactor's rule vocabulary) via the unit test: every rule name in the design section 5 ledger (project-root, absolute-path, email, hostname, private-ip, secret-token, operator-identity, size-shape) fires against the corresponding fixture and the ledger is deterministic across two calls.
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/redact.test.js::redact rule 1: project root becomes <project> and paths under it keep their tail

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-1 (canonical input) via the unit test: fingerprintInput uses <kind>|<targetKey>|<anchor>|<symptomClass>, upper-cases the anchor, excludes blueprint version, and switches to the <kind>|<targetKey>|<symptomClass>|<normalisedTitle> fallback when the anchor is absent.
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/fingerprint.test.js::missing anchor uses the title-fallback canonical input

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-1 (render surface) via the unit test: renderIssue writes the fingerprint twice (visible line and HTML comment) and requests the six-label bootstrap subset for the entry's severity and kind.
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/render.test.js::renderIssue body carries the fingerprint twice and the Environment table

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-4 (safeguard, per-entry) via the unit test: findResidualSecrets detects a multiline PEM shape in a rendered-body-shaped string, which a per-line scan could not see. Binds the whole-text/multiline shape of the residual pass introduced in fix round 2 (R-P0-2 root fix + defence).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-2.test.js::AC-15601-4 safeguard: whole-text residual scan detects a multiline PEM in the rendered surface

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-4 (safeguard, submit half) via the CLI test: an entry whose stealth token slips the first-pass but is caught by the loose-pattern residual scan in the rendered body causes submit --yes --dry-run to exit 3 (entry stays pending; no create/comment path runs).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-2.test.js::AC-15601-4 safeguard: submit refuses (exit 3) when a title-embedded token survives to the rendered body

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fix round 4, F-P0-A) via the unit test: SECRET_KEY_VOCABULARY carries every shortname the HQ gate probes named as leaking (pw, pwd, pass, key, auth) and its regex source is right-bounded at a word edge so `keyword` and `authors` do not fold.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-A (round 4): SECRET_KEY_VOCABULARY carries every shortname the HQ gate probes named as leaking

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fix round 4, F-P0-A) via the probe suite: each of the ten HQ-gate leak inputs (pw=, pwd=, pass=, key=, auth= plus quoted / tab / caps / hyphen / JSON variants) folds under the kv-secret pass and leaves nothing on the residual scan.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-A (round 4): all ten shortname kv probes fold cleanly and leave nothing residual

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fix round 4, F-P0-A negative case) via the unit test: keyword=X and authors=X are NOT folded (right-bound word-edge guard on the vocabulary alternation) so false-positive redactions do not swallow benign prose.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-A (round 4): keyword and authors kv pairs are NOT folded by the right-bound word-edge guard

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fix round 4, F-P0-B) via the unit test: rule 9 (url-credential) folds the Slack webhook path segment to <url-credential> before the rule-4 hostname pass folds the host to <host>, so a webhook URL in prose loses the token but keeps the surrounding text intact.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-B (round 4): Slack webhook path is folded before hostname folding (P07 from the gate)

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fix round 4, F-P0-B) via the unit test: user:pass@host userinfo is dropped by rule 9 so the rule-4 hostname pass still sees a well-formed URL and folds a non-allowlisted host to <host>. The credential does not leak on the wire.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-B (round 4): userinfo (user:pass@host) is dropped and the host still folds via rule 4

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-1 (fix round 4, F-P0-B) via the unit test: URL query parameters whose name matches the shared vocabulary (`?token=`, `?api_key=`) or the presigned-URL set (`?X-Amz-Signature=`) have their values folded to <url-credential>, and a benign allowlisted URL (github.com/foo/bar) has no url-credential ledger row.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-B (round 4): presigned URL query parameter value is redacted

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-4 (fix round 4, safeguard) via the unit test: findResidualSecrets catches both a shortname-key kv shape (pw=...) and a webhook-path shape (/services/.../ or /api/webhooks/.../) in one pass, proving the safeguard shares the same vocabulary as the first-pass redactor.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-P0-A/B (round 4): findResidualSecrets catches shortname kv AND webhook-path shapes in one pass

testCases.description: Cover AC-15601-4 (fix round 4, F-01, design R3c) via the CLI test: `rcf feedback submit --yes --dry-run` writes no files under .rcf/feedback/outbox/ even for the unresolved-destination and whole-destination-fallback branches (previously the dry-run gate on the create/comment path let the bundle write run unconditionally).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-fix-round-4.test.js::F-01 (round 4, R3c): submit --dry-run --yes writes no outbox bundle for an unresolved destination
